work_item: B04 ordinary CLI JSON column selection/projection and explicit report-to-table root-field projection follow-up
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: Explicit table/object input -> sealed input -> unique Core -> selected/projected data with exact source/output evidence and typed stops, then caller-declared downstream consumption
three_document_set: N/A; no construction three-document set specified
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json
initial_state: The three JSON routes existed and were wired through ordinary Core intents; their earlier validation records were build-only. This follow-up adds runtime observations and makes no production implementation or grammar change.

tests_and_route.route_method: Tests launch minidora-rust with --json and fresh real stores, read actual returned report dependencies using actor/case-checked Store::get_bytes, and inspect original requests and complete results in fresh CLI processes. Actual preceding output bytes are supplied as new explicit requests; no action or result is synthesized.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; this batch changes tests/evidence only. The five focused normal-route tests exercise the three projection/selection routes and actual downstream consumption with workspace all-target compile/lint.

route_observations.evidence: All values remain strings and preserve original row order. The selected header and each returned cell range/hash are checked against exact source row/column positions, including empty-row behavior.
Caller column order and original row order are checked; every selected header/cell source range/hash, including the escaped cat token, is checked. Empty rows retain the requested header/schema.

Selected field order, original escaped key ranges, raw value ranges/hashes and complete output key/value cursor maps are checked. Canonically encoded output keys are distinct from original key lexemes. Raw 9007199254740993, 1.2300e+40, nested whitespace and Unicode escape bytes are preserved without reserializing the values.

route_observations.route: actual JsonTableSort report -> direct JsonToCsv stop -> explicit JsonObjectProject columns/rows -> actual projected JsonToCsv
route_observations.observed: Projected data has exactly columns and rows, copied from the actual sort report with raw source/output maps. That actual projected JSON is the next CSV export input; the emitted CSV has the expected full string table and sort order. The earlier direct-export failure remains in prior_results after success. This is explicit caller-fed composition, not an automatically inferred Core plan.

route_observations.route: invalid requested columns/fields and input shapes

render_and_persistence_evidence: All positive cases check COMMIT/COMPUTED, RENDERED, actual render-text SHA-256, content-plan equality, one actor/case-authorized dependency, original request/body and complete result via separate inspect. Object projection also checks stored source/output hashes and the exact displayed projected JSON.
oracle_scope: The fixed source raw keys and row fragments are unique in these fixtures/reports. Root-value extents are found with a standard serde stream byte_offset; actual values are compared as raw slices, not reserialized numeric values. Exact source/output map claims apply to these tested fixtures.

retained_local_evidence.remote_storage_verification: NOT_RUN; local diagnostic-state/log retention only, no OneDrive storage claim

known_limits: These authored examples are scoped QC, not an independent held-out B04 acceptance population.

Table select/project display metadata-bearing reports; root-object projection displays selected JSON directly. Only the explicit projection pipeline tested here establishes report-to-strict-table consumption.
Root projection preserves selected value syntax and does not infer schema validity, factual truth or a safe export policy.

General projections/selection populations, other structured operations, full workspace runtime regression, external LIVE evaluation, Windows/macOS, physical 8 GB QA, release and deployment are NOT_RUN.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; selected ordinary selection/projection and typed-stop routes observed, not the complete B04 contract
